info.title: ICICLE AI Vector Service
info.description:
Vector storage and retrieval service for the ICICLE AI tenant. Clients provide
their own pre-computed embeddings; the service handles storage, filtered search
and reranking.

**Collections** are broad domains (e.g. `biology`, `chemistry`), each backed by
its own Qdrant collection and HNSW index. **Topics** are optional sub-categories
within a collection (e.g. `human`, `plant`).

**User isolation.** Every request is authenticated with a Tapis access token via
the `X-Tapis-Token` header, and `user_id` is taken from the token's
`tapis/username` claim — never from the request body. Each user's collections are
separate Qdrant collections, so users cannot see or affect each other's data, and
each user chooses their own embedding model and vector dimension per collection.

get.description: Liveness/readiness probe. The only endpoint that needs no token.

post.summary: Delete many embeddings in one collection
post.description:
Delete by explicit ids, by topic/metadata predicate, or everything in the collection.

Uses POST rather than DELETE because the selector is a request body, which
DELETE cannot carry portably. Only the caller's own points are ever removed.

parameters.name: detail

schema.description: 'basic' returns names, point counts and dimensions. 'full' also derives topics and embedding models, at two extra Qdrant calls per collection.
schema.title: Detail

parameters.description: 'basic' returns names, point counts and dimensions. 'full' also derives topics and embedding models, at two extra Qdrant calls per collection.

delete.summary: Delete ALL your embeddings across every collection
delete.description:
Irreversible: removes every point the caller owns, in every collection.

Other users' data is untouched. Requires ``?confirm=true`` so that a stray
``DELETE /v1/collections`` cannot wipe an account by accident.

parameters.name: confirm

schema.description: Must be true. Guards against an accidental unqualified DELETE.
schema.title: Confirm

parameters.description: Must be true. Guards against an accidental unqualified DELETE.

delete.summary: Delete your embeddings in one collection
delete.description:
Removes every point the caller owns in this collection.

Other users keep theirs. The Qdrant collection is dropped only if it is left
empty for everyone — reported as ``collection_dropped``.

get.summary: List your embeddings in a collection
get.description: Cursor-paginated listing. Returns metadata only — never vectors.

BulkDeleteRequest.title: BulkDeleteRequest
BulkDeleteRequest.description:
Delete many of the caller's embeddings in one collection.

Exactly one selector must be given: explicit ``ids``, or a
``topic``/``filter`` predicate. ``all=true`` deletes every point the caller
owns in the collection.

collection_dropped.title: Collection Dropped
collection_dropped.description: True when the underlying Qdrant collection was removed because no points from any user remained. Always false unless the deployment sets DROP_EMPTY_COLLECTIONS=true.

topics.title: Topics
topics.description: Null unless detail=full. Capped at 100 distinct values.

embedding_models.title: Embedding Models
embedding_models.description: Null unless detail=full. Capped at 100 distinct values.

truncated.title: Truncated
truncated.description: True when topics or embedding_models hit the 100-value cap and the list is incomplete.

CollectionInfo.title: CollectionInfo
CollectionInfo.description:
A collection as seen by the requesting user.

``points`` counts only the caller's own points, never every user's, so this
cannot be used to infer how much data other users hold.

next_offset.title: Next Offset
next_offset.description: Pass as ?offset= for the next page. Null on the last page.

next_offset.title: Next Offset
next_offset.description: Pass as ?offset= to fetch the next page. Null on the last page.

EmbeddingListResponse.title: EmbeddingListResponse
EmbeddingListResponse.description: A page of the caller's embeddings in one collection (metadata only).

cross_encoder.title: Cross Encoder
cross_encoder.description: Whether cross-encoder reranking is installed in this deployment.

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.description: Key-value pairs to match against the metadata payload field

MetadataFilter.title: MetadataFilter
MetadataFilter.description:
Filter results by metadata fields.

Each key-value pair matches against the nested ``metadata`` payload field.
All conditions are ANDed together. Values can be:
  - a string/number/bool for exact match
  - a list for "any of" match

Keys are namespaced under ``metadata.`` when translated to Qdrant, so this
cannot be used to address a top-level payload field such as ``user_id``.

PurgeResponse.title: PurgeResponse
PurgeResponse.description: Result of deleting everything the caller owns, across all collections.

available.title: Available
available.description: False when the method's dependencies are missing from this deployment.

query_text.title: Query Text
query_text.description: Raw query string. Required for method='cross_encoder', which scores the query against each candidate's text. Ignored by the vector-only methods ('mmr', 'cosine_rescore').

rerank_model.title: Rerank Model
rerank_model.description: Cross-encoder model to use. Must be one of the models the deployment allows (see GET /v1/rerank/methods). Defaults to the service's configured model. Only used by method='cross_encoder'.

lambda.title: Lambda
lambda.description: MMR relevance/diversity trade-off. Only used by method='mmr'.

model.title: Model
model.description: Reranker model used. Null for the vector-only methods.

RerankedItem.title: RerankedItem
RerankedItem.description:
A result carrying both the vector score and the reranker's score.

``score`` stays the original cosine similarity from the vector search so
clients can compare the two rankings; ``rerank_score`` is what the ordering
is actually based on.

TapisToken.name: X-Tapis-Token
TapisToken.description: ICICLE AI tenant Tapis access token. The username is read from the tapis/username claim and used to isolate your data.
